proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Relating to Action by Written Consent
proposals.proponent: Myra K. Young (submitted through John Chevedden)
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to permit shareholders entitled to cast the minimum votes needed to act to take action by written consent, to equalize special meeting rights.
proposals.evidence: ITEM 5 RECOMMENDATION: Our Board of Directors recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.
